[SPOILER=The Emperor's coronation]
[i]The litter carrying the so-soon emperor, Chumun-Caur, pass throught the road connecting Chanchán to the Chillakóri, soon they arrive the entrance, the Sapa got down from the litter, and then wave his hand toward the crowd.
[/i]
"We are at the 56.981 cycle, for the first time since the cycle 51543(Janurary 1572), Chimor have a sapa, for the first time since the Colonial Era, we have a sapa, and i have the honour of being the new one.
[b]Clear throat[/b]
Chilla has made her choice, the new Emperor of silver and gold reign will start now, the Mandate of Silver now gets stronger".
He proceeds to enter the imperial Temple, without a clear reason, him and the Imperial family soon dissapear in the halls of the Temple of silver(It has many hidden paths).

[b]The Mancu and the Sapa[/b].
The bhapac  stands on the middle of the throne room, he look at the [i]munaos[/i](mummies) of the Three Great, he kneel standing his arm over his leg to pray respect.
[i]Are you ready, majesty?[/i].
The Elder says upon entering the room.
[i]Yes, it is time.[/i]
He agrees, soon the elder put a bag of jewelries, shells, corn, and others on the ground.
[i]Kurakas and governors of all the country  decided to make this offering for your majesty.[/i]
[i]Very well, tell them i accept, their gifts are more than appreciated for such important moment.[/i]
The bhapac says, while taking a mantle of silver from the bag, it was made by the many skilled artisans of the Harem,it was shining as silver, adorned with jewelry, the mantle colour were tones of silver, alongside jewels such as aquamarines and pearls, the crown had platinum, silver, decorated with aquamarines, pearls, amethysts, and lapis-lazulis.
[b]Coronation proper[/b]
Sit down on his throne, the bhapac awaits, as the kurakas, royal family, government members and invited people enters, he waves his hand, and the crown is gave to him by the elder Chumbi Chacat, who kneel to him touching his forehead on the soil as extreme respect.
[i]So let this day be known, taht today the Empire has ressurged, by the strenght of Chatay and the wisdom of Chilla, Chimor becomes stronger, no man if not the choosen one by Chilla can rule the mandate, and the choosen is [b]me[/b][/i]
As soon the Sapa finishes, his hands put the crown on his head, and the moonlight soon illuminate the throne, showing he was the choosen one indeed.
He takes a silver scepter, then soon raises it.
"Taycanamo, the imperial founder, Ñancenpinco, the founder of the second dynasty, and Mìnchankamán, the conqueror , Náymur-Iálluk, the modernizer, now I will some day take the place as the 5th greatest among you all, Chumun-Caur, the one who revived the empire.
" Taht Apû-Samán bless my justice as unshakable as the mountains, Cochanamo bless my rule as inexorable as the seas, fluid as the winds of Kón, and show no cowardice and be strong as Chaska."
Soon he takes a sipof Chicha, a holy drink, then soon spit it all[Imagine like Triple H entrance from WWE], as a form of "illumination" and "blessing", then gives a look to the Awi Chay Ullapán at Mama Cagén arms, and then slightly tap of the tip of the scepter on his forehead and says.
"And you will the most imperial heir be, the Awi is your title, the successor of Mandate if taht is what Chilla wish"
[/spoiler]
